about: Models for Abyssal Garden (https://github.com/Nessuno6/abyssal-garden). Each model keeps its own licence; see README.md.

models.name: creature_evolution_2_anim
models.title: Creature Evolution #2
models.author: alexalbinyana
models.changes: Rigged (18 bones) and animated in Blender; materials converted to metallic-roughness.

models.name: reaper_leviathan_anim
models.title: Reaper Leviathan
models.author: patrat623
models.changes: Re-rigged (33 bones) and animated in Blender; materials converted to metallic-roughness.
models.note: Fan model of a creature from Subnautica (Unknown Worlds Entertainment). The licence covers the modelling work, not the original design.

models.name: subnautica_hydra_submarine_anim
models.title: Subnautica: Hydra Submarine
models.author: Aci
models.changes: Rigged (propellers, rudders, hatches) and animated in Blender; textures scaled down to 2048 px; materials converted to metallic-roughness.

models.name: subnautica_hydra_submarine_anim_interior
models.title: Hydra Submarine: cockpit and command centre
models.author: Aci
models.changes: Interior (cockpit with a panoramic window, command centre, station markers) modelled in Blender for Abyssal Garden inside the Hydra hull, reworked with smooth white panels, hex floor and teal screens; a derivative of the Hydra, so under the same licence.
models.note: Non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 4.0). Add it together with the Hydra submarine.

models.name: diver_swim
models.title: Diver
models.author: nolanfa
models.changes: Posed prone, rigged (20 bones) and animated in Blender. Bundled with the game as the player model.

models.name: lantern_leviathan
models.title: Lantern Leviathan
models.author: Nessuno6 (Abyssal Garden)
models.changes: Original model, made in Blender for Abyssal Garden: modelled, textured, rigged (55 bones) and animated. The game's built-in leviathan.
